note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Table of contents -- renders: 'Contents' label, unpin button, and section headings derived from the article structure
Page title bar -- renders: article title and language selector button
Right navigation tabs and tools -- renders: 'Read', 'Edit', 'View history', 'Tools' dropdown
Appearance settings -- renders: 'Appearance' label, font size options (Small, Standard, Large), width options (Standard, Wide), theme options (OS, Day, Night)
Site subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Footer -- renders: last modified timestamp, rendered with MediaWiki, copyright notice, license links, and site policy links (Privacy, About, Disclaimers, Contact, etc.)
